import os, re, json, glob, subprocess, sys
OUT = os.path.expanduser('~/recordings/solution-v2/raw')
start = open('/tmp/hz-700-run-start').read().strip()
NAMES = {'A1': 'A1-homepage', 'A2': 'A2-get-access', 'A3': 'A3-promo-checkout', 'A4': 'A4-welcome', 'A5': 'A5-google-sign-in', 'A6': 'A6-first-project', 'A7': 'A7-connect-repo'}
lines = [l for l in open(os.path.join(OUT, 'run.log')) if l[:19] >= start]
BOUND = re.compile(r' (run: |scene A\d (ok \d+ ms|FAILED))')
failed = sorted({m.group(1) for m in (re.search(r' scene (A\d) FAILED', l) for l in lines) if m})
scenes = {}
for sid, name in NAMES.items():
    src, dst = os.path.join(OUT, sid + '.mp4'), os.path.join(OUT, name + '.mp4')
    oks = [i for i, l in enumerate(lines) if re.search(r' scene ' + sid + r' ok \d+ ms', l)]
    info = {'attempts': sum(' scene ' + sid + ' launch:' in l for l in lines), 'passed': bool(oks)}
    if oks and os.path.exists(src):
        end = oks[-1]
        begin = max([i for i in range(end) if BOUND.search(lines[i])], default=-1) + 1
        part = [l for l in lines[begin:end + 1] if ' scene ' + sid in l]
        os.replace(src, dst)
        with os.fdopen(os.open(os.path.join(OUT, name + '.log'), os.O_WRONLY | os.O_CREAT | os.O_TRUNC, 0o600), 'w') as f:
            f.writelines(part)
        size = subprocess.run(['ffprobe', '-v', 'error', '-select_streams', 'v:0', '-show_entries', 'stream=width,height', '-of', 'csv=p=0', dst], capture_output=True, text=True).stdout.strip()
        errs = subprocess.run(['ffmpeg', '-v', 'error', '-i', dst, '-f', 'null', '-'], capture_output=True, text=True).stderr.strip()
        info.update(size=size, decode_errors=len(errs.splitlines()), log_lines=len(part), failed_steps=sum('FAILED' in l for l in part))
    scenes[name] = info
mp4s = sorted(os.path.basename(p) for p in glob.glob(os.path.join(OUT, '*.mp4')))
m1 = mp4s == sorted(n + '.mp4' for n in NAMES.values()) and all(s.get('size') == '1920,1080' and s.get('decode_errors') == 0 for s in scenes.values())
m2 = all(os.path.exists(os.path.join(OUT, n + '.log')) and s.get('log_lines', 0) > 0 and s.get('failed_steps') == 0 for n, s in scenes.items())
reshot = sorted(n for n, s in scenes.items() if s['attempts'] > 1)
json.dump({'mp4s': mp4s, 'scenes': scenes, 'failed_attempts': failed, 'reshot': reshot, 'metric1': m1, 'metric2': m2}, open('/tmp/hz-700-recordings.json', 'w'), indent=1)
print('METRIC1', 'PASS' if m1 else 'FAIL', json.dumps({'mp4s': len(mp4s), 'sizes': sorted({s.get('size') for s in scenes.values()} - {None}), 'decode_errors': sum(s.get('decode_errors', 0) for s in scenes.values())}))
print('METRIC2', 'PASS' if m2 else 'FAIL', json.dumps({'logs': sum(os.path.exists(os.path.join(OUT, n + '.log')) for n in NAMES.values()), 'failed_steps': sum(s.get('failed_steps', 0) for s in scenes.values()), 'failed_attempts': failed, 'reshot': reshot}))
sys.exit(0 if m1 and m2 else 1)
